staging_set.why: Lens scores: maintainer-fit 6, evidence 8, impact 7; strict geometric mean 6.95, the highest in the set. A silent wrong-region edit in the most-used coding tool is a correctness bug (CONTRIBUTING priority 1, 'fail loud'). On main e496ccc7d7, Teknium's c0b0c88626 already makes context_aware require every non-blank line >= 0.80 (tools/fuzzy_match.py:261-285). The defects that remain are block_anchor's 0.50 middle threshold (:247, which the #54572 repro hits) and single-line context_aware, where the first line is the last line (the #125376 trim()/strip() case at 0.923). The two external carriers disagree on these cases: #54575's 0.90 normalized floor would still pass the 0.923 case. The WAVE.md pattern (A/B the carriers, then a Co-authored-by fold-in) is the channel that lands, scores salvage_cherry 3, and uses no slot. The meter half already ships as hermes.file_edit.count (8d8836ddb1), so it is reused rather than rebuilt. Critic correction applied: #111127's author is KoNit-K. KeyArgo's 6/6 vs 5/6 scorecard ran on 602e596389b, and the head is now 5444b1a2a8.
staging_set.first_slice: One commit on fresh main, containing only a behaviour-contract regression test (e.g. tests/tools/test_fuzzy_match_wrong_region.py). staging_set.title: Evidence and rebase support for #107731 boundary-stable tool-result projection
staging_set.why: Lens scores: maintainer-fit 5, impact 7. The evidence lens did not score this feature, so evidence is estimated at 5 here. This has the highest demand in the catalog (55; #39691 r=17). Teknium's 2026-09-23 note on #107731 prescribes exactly this shape and asks for a cache-read ratio before and after. kshitijk4poor left three maintainer questions open. The author, lorencato23, is active: live A/Bs show -89.5% (DeepSeek) and -90.2% (Luna) prompt tokens with recall 8/8. So the role is support, not competition. Critic correction: proactive_prune_tokens defaults to 0 (config_defaults.py:617), so headroom is not reduced by pruning, and arms need both prune-off and prune-on baselines. New finding, verified in the claude-api reference: on preserved-thinking Anthropic models (Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5), a client-side rewrite of earlier tool results counts as a history edit. Later thinking blocks are then dropped, or the request 400s for accounts created on or after 2026-08-31. Server-side clear_tool_uses does not count as an edit. Preserved-thinking replay PRs are in flight today (#129620, #129492, #129882), so the projection must be gated off on those routes or proven inert there.
staging_set.first_slice: One commit, offered as review evidence or a fold-in, never as our own PR. It adds a $0 FakeLLMServer test: across N turns between two prune/compaction boundaries the projected request prefix stays byte-identical (cache_prefix_wire's message-signature diff, ported onto a recording fake). The projection fires once per row at the boundary. On an anthropic_messages route with a preserved-thinking model it is a no-op, or the test documents what gets dropped.

staging_set.title: evals/postmortem: count zero-hit and usage-unavailable calls in logcalls; isolate run.py probe homes
staging_set.why: Lens scores: evidence 9, impact 4. Maintainer-fit is estimated at 4 because that lens did not score this item; its base-rate note says outside evals changes land only as bug fixes. Verified on e496ccc7d7: logcalls._LINE (evals/postmortem/forensics/logcalls.py:27-29) requires 'cache=R/P'. agent/turn_usage.py emits cache= only when cache_read_tokens > 0 (:191-193), and the 'usage=unavailable' line (:96) never matches. So every full miss is dropped, coverage is undercounted and the hit ratio is biased upward. That biases the $0 baselines for E19, E37 and cache-warming sizing. Teknium cares about this parser: his open #119713 places ttfb= last 'so the forensics parser's latency=..s cache= adjacency ... keep matching'. A real carrier exists: #121135 (Wenfengcheng, merge-tree clean on main) adds cache_state=hit|miss|cold_write|no_field but keeps cache= positive-only. logcalls would still drop misses after it lands, so the parser update is a natural Co-authored-by fold-in that rides with a real fix (D5). Two more hazards are verified: run.py:47 uses env.setdefault('HERMES_HOME'), so an exported real home leaks into probes, and the run.py:41 cache_prefix_wire marker '' passes vacuously.
staging_set.first_slice: One commit. logcalls._LINE makes ' cache=(\d+)/(\d+)' optional, defaulting to 0. 'usage=unavailable' lines are accepted but counted separately and never enter the hit ratio. cache_state= is read when present (#121135) to separate a miss from no_field, and a trailing ttfb= (#119713) is tolerated. Add three synthetic lines (miss, unavailable, hit) to evals/postmortem/tests/test_postmortem_harness.py, asserting coverage and hit ratio. The run.py fixes come in later commits: always a fresh temp HERMES_HOME, and a non-empty cache_prefix_wire marker.
